"""LedgerList reconciliation: canonical row keys, ordering, and selection.

``LedgerList`` must reconcile its children by canonical ``control_id`` instead
of rebuilding them, honour the explicit order the screen supplies (so the
all-fields mode is never re-filtered), render section headers by status, and
render the scanning placeholder for an empty slice.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError

import pytest
from textual.widgets import Static

from src.tui.projections.models import FieldProjection
from src.tui.screens.trace_support.ledger import LedgerData, LedgerList, LedgerRow
from src.tui.widgets.trace import FieldListData
from tests.tui.support.ledger_view import (
    ENTRY_CLASS,
    SELECTED_CLASS,
    ledger_entries,
    ledger_field,
    mount_ledger_list,
)

_EMPTY_TEXT = "Scanning page for fields..."
_HIDDEN_GENERATED_ID = "generated-blank"


def _child_names(list_widget: LedgerList) -> list[str]:
    """Return child widget names in mount order, including ``None`` headers."""
    return [str(child.name) for child in list_widget.children]


def _sections(list_widget: LedgerList) -> list[str]:
    """Return the status section headers rendered by the ledger."""
    return [
        str(child.name)
        for child in list_widget.children
        if "trace-field-section" in child.classes
    ]


async def test_rows_are_keyed_by_canonical_control_id() -> None:
    """Each field renders one named entry row under its status header."""
    async with mount_ledger_list() as (list_widget, pilot):
        list_widget.data = LedgerData(
            fields={"alpha": ledger_field("alpha"), "beta": ledger_field("beta")},
            selected_id="",
        )
        await pilot.pause()
        names = _child_names(list_widget)
        children = [*list_widget.children]

    assert names == ["section:pending", "alpha", "beta"], (
        f"rows must be keyed by canonical control ID: {names}"
    )
    assert all(ENTRY_CLASS in child.classes for child in children[1:]), (
        "every field row must carry the field-entry class"
    )
    assert _sections(list_widget) == ["section:pending"], (
        "one status header must group the pending fields"
    )


async def test_unchanged_rows_keep_identity_and_render_new_text() -> None:
    """Re-reconciling updates the changed row instead of remounting rows."""
    async with mount_ledger_list() as (list_widget, pilot):
        list_widget.data = LedgerData(
            fields={"alpha": ledger_field("alpha"), "beta": ledger_field("beta")},
            selected_id="",
        )
        await pilot.pause()
        before = ledger_entries(list_widget)
        updated = ledger_field("beta")
        updated.proposed_value = "reconciled"
        list_widget.data = LedgerData(
            fields={"alpha": ledger_field("alpha"), "beta": updated},
            selected_id="",
        )
        await pilot.pause()
        after = ledger_entries(list_widget)

    assert before["alpha"] is after["alpha"], (
        "the unchanged row must keep its widget identity"
    )
    assert before["beta"] is after["beta"], (
        "the changed row must be updated rather than remounted"
    )
    assert "reconciled" in str(after["beta"].content), (
        "the changed row must render the new projected value"
    )


async def test_rows_are_dropped_when_no_longer_desired() -> None:
    """A field missing from the new slice is removed from the ledger."""
    async with mount_ledger_list() as (list_widget, pilot):
        list_widget.data = LedgerData(
            fields={"alpha": ledger_field("alpha"), "beta": ledger_field("beta")},
            selected_id="",
        )
        await pilot.pause()
        list_widget.data = LedgerData(fields={"alpha": ledger_field("alpha")})
        await pilot.pause()
        names = _child_names(list_widget)

    assert names == ["section:pending", "alpha"], (
        f"the removed field must not keep a row: {names}"
    )


async def test_empty_slice_renders_the_scanning_placeholder() -> None:
    """An empty page renders one unnamed placeholder row."""
    async with mount_ledger_list() as (list_widget, pilot):
        list_widget.data = LedgerData()
        await pilot.pause()
        children = [*list_widget.children]

    assert len(children) == 1, "the empty ledger must render exactly one row"
    assert children[0].name is None, "the placeholder row must not claim a field"
    assert _EMPTY_TEXT in str(children[0].content), (
        "the placeholder must tell the operator the page is still being scanned"
    )


async def test_selected_row_carries_the_selection_class() -> None:
    """Selection is marked on the canonical row the screen names."""
    async with mount_ledger_list() as (list_widget, pilot):
        list_widget.data = LedgerData(
            fields={"alpha": ledger_field("alpha"), "beta": ledger_field("beta")},
            selected_id="beta",
        )
        await pilot.pause()
        entries = ledger_entries(list_widget)

    assert SELECTED_CLASS in entries["beta"].classes, (
        "the selected field's row must render as selected"
    )
    assert SELECTED_CLASS not in entries["alpha"].classes, (
        "an unselected row must not render as selected"
    )


async def test_explicit_order_exposes_ids_default_grouping_hides() -> None:
    """An explicit ``ordered_ids`` slice is never re-filtered by grouping."""
    async with mount_ledger_list() as (list_widget, pilot):
        fields = {
            "alpha": ledger_field("alpha"),
            _HIDDEN_GENERATED_ID: ledger_field(_HIDDEN_GENERATED_ID),
        }
        list_widget.data = FieldListData(fields=dict(fields), selected_id="")
        await pilot.pause()
        grouped = _child_names(list_widget)
        list_widget.data = LedgerData(
            fields=dict(fields),
            selected_id="",
            ordered_ids=(_HIDDEN_GENERATED_ID, "alpha"),
        )
        await pilot.pause()
        explicit = _child_names(list_widget)

    assert _HIDDEN_GENERATED_ID not in grouped, (
        "default grouping must hide the zero-evidence blank helper"
    )
    assert explicit == [
        "section:pending",
        _HIDDEN_GENERATED_ID,
        "alpha",
    ], f"an explicit order must render every requested ID in order: {explicit}"


def test_ledger_row_records_are_frozen() -> None:
    """Row records are frozen so reconciliation can cache them across frames."""
    row = LedgerRow(key="alpha", text="alpha", classes=ENTRY_CLASS, name="alpha")
    with pytest.raises(FrozenInstanceError):
        row.key = "beta"  # type: ignore[misc]
